facts.claim: 叙述者说不许任何人读这份手稿，她决定不再为自己守秘密，但如今要为凯也守住一个秘密。
facts.quote: I’ve got a secret to keep not just on my own behalf, but on Kay’s as well.

facts.claim: 她原以为被自己视为受害者的 Eli Pratt 并没有那么糊涂，他和 Austin Gregory 之间显然有约定：一个消失，另一个便跟随。
facts.quote: if the one disappeared, the other was to follow

facts.claim: “Austin Gregory”在狱中死于芬太尼过量，Dead Horse 监狱随即关闭，狱长 Aaron Gubler 转行做私人教练。
facts.quote: “Austin Gregory” had died in prison of a fentanyl overdose of his own

facts.claim: Martina Becerra 按凯的意愿被转去了更好的机构，她坚称 Deirdre Gregory 不可能自杀，但没有人听她。
facts.quote: Martina Becerra was placed at a better institution, just as Kay intended.

facts.claim: 周一清晨她带着难看的宿醉醒来，一心想回纽约、把这一带抛在脑后，却被守在楼梯下的 Denny 拦住。
facts.quote: I woke up early on Monday morning with a filthy hangover

facts.claim: Denny 和 Abi 也要去机场，他直接断定她坐的是飞凤凰城的早班机，并提议顺路一起去看她父母。
facts.quote: I assume you’re on the early-bird flight to Phoenix

facts.claim: Denny 早已查好她父母还住在她长大的那栋房子里，距机场不到二十分钟，她终究没能推脱。
facts.quote: They’re in the same house. The one you grew up in.

facts.claim: 两人从凤凰城机场打车到 Mesa，车停在她童年的家门前；她说自己害怕，Denny 说他会一直在这儿，而她还没走到门口，门就开了。
facts.quote: It opened before I could reach it.

relations.rel: 她第一次替别人——替凯——保守秘密
relations.quote: I’ve got a secret to keep not just on my own behalf, but on Kay’s as well.

relations.rel: 两人约定一个消失另一个便跟随
relations.quote: if the one disappeared, the other was to follow
Me and Abi, yeah. We’re heading to the airport.

relations.rel: 她害怕时他答应一直在门外等着
她教会叙述者承认自己是受害者并非软弱
relations.quote: it was Genevieve who taught me that owning one’s victimhood isn’t a weakness

relations.rel: 卡罗让叙述者想起十七岁有多年轻，从而劝自己对当年的自己宽容
relations.quote: Caro reminds me to be kind to that poor, misguided seventeen-year-old girl

numbers.claim: 她第一次不只为自己守秘密
numbers.quote: But for the first time, I’ve got a secret to keep

numbers.claim: 二十年前她也曾这样离开这一带
numbers.quote: Just as I had done twenty years earlier.

numbers.claim: 楼梯下已经放着另外两只行李
她宿醉醒来的那个周一清晨
numbers.quote: I woke up early on Monday morning with a filthy hangover

numbers.claim: 父母家距凤凰城机场不到二十分钟车程
numbers.quote: It’s less than twenty minutes from the airport, I mapped it.

numbers.claim: 她反复想到十七岁有多么年轻
她劝自己善待当年那个十七岁的女孩
numbers.quote: Caro reminds me to be kind to that poor, misguided seventeen-year-old girl

numbers.claim: 没有人听 Martina 说 Deirdre 不可能自杀
不出一个月，狱中的“Austin Gregory”也死了
numbers.quote: Before the month was over, “Austin Gregory” had died in prison

numbers.claim: 现实比惊悚小说里那种会构成威胁的人更可怕
numbers.quote: a much scarier situation than one of those thrillers

turning_point: 她终于站到童年家门口：不再靠敲门等待宣判，门在她伸手之前自己开了——二十年前逃离的过去主动迎上她。
notes: 结尾“门自己开了”未交代开门者是谁，原文本章到此为止；Eli Pratt 与 Austin Gregory 的约定只是叙述者推测（“There must have been an understanding”）。
